company.name: ExcepGen
company.shortDescription: RNA based vaccines with tolerability close to the standard of care by dampening an excessive innate immune response
company.description: ExcepGen is a venture-backed, early stage biotechnology company located in San Francisco. The company is focused on solving fundamental underlying problems in drug discovery and applying those solutions to create a new generation of therapeutics.

productsAndServices.description: An mRNA encoded protein platform that modulates cellular response to RNA and lipid nanoparticles by reducing excessive innate immune activation.
productsAndServices.name: RNAx Platform

productsAndServices.description: Vaccines that use self-replicating mRNA to produce antigens, enhancing immune response with potentially lower doses.
productsAndServices.name: Self-amplifying mRNA Vaccines

productsAndServices.description: Vaccines employing a two-component mRNA system where one mRNA encodes replication machinery to amplify antigen-encoding mRNA, enhancing vaccine efficacy.
productsAndServices.name: Trans-amplifying mRNA Vaccines

productsAndServices.description: Vaccines based on messenger RNA that instruct cells to produce antigens to stimulate an immune response.
productsAndServices.name: mRNA Vaccines

aiResearchSummary.text: ExcepGen is researching compositions and methods for protein expression with RNA that encode nuclear cytoplasmic transport inhibitor proteins to enhance expression of target proteins from DNA vectors, messenger RNA, self amplifying RNA and related constructs. They also develop vaccine compositions and methods of use thereof in which a polynucleotide encodes both a viral antigen protein and a nucleocytoplasmic transport inhibitor protein, and broader systems and methods for protein expression, covering RNA therapeutics, vaccines and delivery platforms.
